## `anime-teaser`

Make Genobi's Anime teaser template (docs/anime-teaser-template.md) - take or generate a track, a character sheet and a storyboard, then two 10-second MiniMax H3 shots from the sheet and the storyboard, cut to the track's beat in the Director with two titles. Every paid step is quoted and waits for the person's approval.

## `genobi-teaser-run`

Recreate the Genobi teaser end to end as a reproducible run - analyse the track, derive every shot and overlay from the brief's storyboard, the analysis and the capture log with the decision rules, keep every on-screen word to the claim rules, write and verify the cut JSON, render it, review the contact sheet and save memory - then repeat it from the first run's memory alone. ## `genobi-upscale`

Upscale a video in Genobi from start to finish - inspect the clip, choose SeedVR2 (open, free on a local GPU) or FLUX Video Upscale (API), run one upscale up to 20 s or plan a longer clip in 19 s parts behind one combined quote and one approval, wait while the parts are upscaled and joined with the clip's own sound, then report the joined clip and every part's state. Never resends an uncertain part.
